description: The Asymmetric Matrix breaks the 2×2 constraint: define a different number of zones above and below a horizontal reference line, independently configured. Drop any two numeric measures onto X and Y axes. Set a reference value that splits the chart into upper and lower halves. Then add vertical dividers in each half — up to 4 above, up to 4 below (Pro) — each with its own label, color, and opacity. Click any zone to cross-filter the rest of your report. FREE includes: scatter plot with up to 5 upper zones, configurable Y-reference line, zone labels and colors, category color grouping, bubble size field, tooltips (up to 10 fields), and cross-filter on zone click. PRO adds: lower zone asymmetry (up to 5 independent zones below the reference line), X and Y axis titles, fixed axis range for stable cross-filtering, data labels on each point, and zone count cards. No external dependencies. Works in Power BI Desktop, Service, Embedded, and Mobile.
